title: Stages
description: History board: stages and issues compared, drill-down from a stage to an issue, a launch and its steps.

panels.title: Tokens per stage, by role
panels.description: Tokens in millions per stage of the project, one segment per role. The hover shows each segment and the total (the series "total" on a hidden scale, no fill). The dashed grey line for the typical stage (median of the stage totals of the other stages of the project, needs three such stages) is not drawn: the built-in bar chart cannot take a threshold line from a query. The hidden query B holds the guarded median. A click on a bar selects that stage (filter stage). Time range: the last 365 days, fixed, so a drill-down to a launch does not shrink it.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, role) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!=""}[$__range])) / 1e6 or label_replace(sum by (stage) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!=""}[$__range])) / 1e6, "role", "total", "", "")

panels.title: Active time per stage, by role
panels.description: Active time per stage of the project, one segment per role, with the total in the hover. The dashed grey line for the typical stage (median of the stage totals of the other stages of the project, needs three such stages) is not drawn: the built-in bar chart cannot take a threshold line from a query. The hidden query B holds the guarded median. A click on a bar selects that stage (filter stage). Time range: the last 365 days, fixed, so a drill-down to a launch does not shrink it.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, role) (sum_over_time(agk:active_seconds:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!=""}[$__range])) or label_replace(sum by (stage) (sum_over_time(agk:active_seconds:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!=""}[$__range])), "role", "total", "", "")

panels.title: Token kinds per stage
panels.description: Tokens in millions per stage, one segment per token kind (cache read, cache creation, output, input), with the total in the hover. A click on a bar selects that stage (filter stage). Time range: the last 365 days, fixed, so a drill-down to a launch does not shrink it.

targets.expr: sum by (stage, kind) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!=""}[$__range])) / 1e6 or label_replace(sum by (stage) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!=""}[$__range])) / 1e6, "kind", "total", "", "")

panels.title: Selected stage: tokens per issue, by role
panels.description: The chart "Tokens per issue, by role" of the live board for the stage in the filter: tokens in millions per issue in execution order, one segment per role, issues not started as empty slots, the total in the hover. The typical issue line is not drawn (hidden query B, as on the live board). A click on a bar selects that issue (filter issue) for the launches table. Time range: the last 365 days, fixed, so a drill-down to a launch does not shrink it.

targets.expr: (sum by (issue, role) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!=""}[$__range])) / 1e6 * on (issue) group_left (slot) label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(topk by (issue) (1, last_over_time(agk_issue_info{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage"}[365d])),"ord","0$1","order","^(\\d)$"),"ord","$1","order","^(\\d\\d+)$"),"short","$1","title","^(.{0,20}).*"),"slot"," · ","ord","issue","short")) or (label_replace(label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(topk by (issue) (1, last_over_time(agk_issue_info{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage"}[365d])),"ord","0$1","order","^(\\d)$"),"ord","$1","order","^(\\d\\d+)$"),"short","$1","title","^(.{0,20}).*"),"slot"," · ","ord","issue","short") * 0, "role", "pending", "", "") unless on (issue) sum by (issue) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!=""}[$__range]))) or label_replace(sum by (issue) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage",issue!=""}[$__range])) / 1e6 * on (issue) group_left (slot) label_join(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(topk by (issue) (1, last_over_time(agk_issue_info{agk_project="$project",stage="$stage"}[365d])),"ord","0$1","order","^(\\d)$"),"ord","$1","order","^(\\d\\d+)$"),"short","$1","title","^(.{0,20}).*"),"slot"," · ","ord","issue","short"), "role", "total", "", "")

(quantile(0.5, sum by (stage, issue) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="$stage",stage!="",issue!=""}[365d]))) and on () (count(count by (stage) (last_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="$stage",stage!=""}[365d]))) >= 3)) / 1e6

panels.title: Most expensive issues of all stages
panels.description: The ten issues of the project with the most tokens (in millions), over all stages, largest on top, labelled "stage · #issue", one segment per role, the total in the hover. A click on a bar selects that stage and issue. Time range: the last 365 days, fixed, so a drill-down to a launch does not shrink it.

targets.expr: label_join(sum by (stage, issue, role) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="",issue!=""}[$__range])) and on (stage, issue) topk(10, sum by (stage, issue) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="",issue!=""}[$__range]))), "slot", " · #", "stage", "issue") / 1e6 or label_replace(label_join(topk(10, sum by (stage, issue) (sum_over_time(agk:tokens:1m{agk_project="$project",stage!="",issue!=""}[$__range]))), "slot", " · #", "stage", "issue") / 1e6, "role", "total", "", "")

panels.title: Steps of the launch
panels.description: One bar per tool call at its time, its height the duration; rose above 2 minutes (log scale, so short calls stay visible). The hover gives the tool and its target. The line is the context size of each API request (input + cache read + cache creation tokens, right axis), one point per request. Only the events of the selected launch: open a launch with a click on its row in "Launches of the issue" (or pick it in the filter launch). This panel has its own time range: the first to last minute of the launch in agk:active_seconds:1m, computed when the board loads, so it does not depend on the board range and stays the same after a reload. The events of the role of the launch in that window are shown. For a qa-codex launch this panel stays empty: Codex sends other events (Codex steps: issue #322). Tool targets need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1.

targets.expr: {agk_project="$project"} |= "claude_code.tool_result" | label_format agk_role=`{{ if eq .query_source "main" }}orchestrator{{ else }}{{ with regexReplaceAll "^.*:" .agent_name "" }}{{ if eq . "pm" }}pm{{ else if or (eq . "software-engineer") (eq . "frontend-engineer") }}engineer{{ else if eq . "qa-engineer" }}qa-claude{{ else if eq . "planner" }}planner{{ else }}other{{ end }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}{{ end }}` | label_format agk_in_launch=`{{ if hasPrefix (printf "%s-" (regexReplaceAll "^qa-claude$" .agk_role "qa")) "$launch" }}1{{ end }}` | agk_in_launch="1" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json file_path="file_path", full_command="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | duration_ms <= 120000 | label_format agk_target="{{.file_path}}{{.full_command}}"

panels.title: Launches of the issue
panels.description: One row per launch of a subagent on the issue in the filter (the orchestrator has no row), in start order. Return is the attempt number minus one. A click on a row opens the steps of that launch (sets the filter launch; the steps panels then show the first to last minute of the launch). Time range: the last 365 days, fixed, so a drill-down to a launch does not shrink it.

panels.title: Steps of the launch (table)
panels.description: The tool calls and API requests of the selected launch in time order: step number, tool (an API request shows "API request" and the model as target), target, duration, tokens of the API request (input + output + cache read + cache creation), time. Only the events of the selected launch: open a launch with a click on its row in "Launches of the issue" (or pick it in the filter launch). This panel has its own time range: the first to last minute of the launch in agk:active_seconds:1m, computed when the board loads, so it does not depend on the board range and stays the same after a reload. The events of the role of the launch in that window are shown. For a qa-codex launch this panel stays empty: Codex sends other events (Codex steps: issue #322). Tool targets need OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1.

targets.expr: {agk_project="$project"} |= "claude_code.tool_result" or "claude_code.api_request" | label_format agk_role=`{{ if eq .query_source "main" }}orchestrator{{ else }}{{ with regexReplaceAll "^.*:" .agent_name "" }}{{ if eq . "pm" }}pm{{ else if or (eq . "software-engineer") (eq . "frontend-engineer") }}engineer{{ else if eq . "qa-engineer" }}qa-claude{{ else if eq . "planner" }}planner{{ else }}other{{ end }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}{{ end }}` | label_format agk_in_launch=`{{ if hasPrefix (printf "%s-" (regexReplaceAll "^qa-claude$" .agk_role "qa")) "$launch" }}1{{ end }}` | agk_in_launch="1" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json file_path="file_path", full_command="full_command" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format agk_tool=`{{ or .tool_name "API request" }}`, agk_target=`{{ .file_path }}{{ .full_command }}{{ if .input_tokens }}{{ .model }}{{ end }}`, agk_tokens=`{{ if .input_tokens }}{{ add (int .input_tokens) (int .output_tokens) (int .cache_read_tokens) (int .cache_creation_tokens) }}{{ end }}`

panels.title: Kit document reads per role
panels.description: One bar per role: how often its agents read a kit document (a Read of a file under docs/, .agents/skills/ or plugin/skills/, or of AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md). The hover gives each document and its read count. Time range: the last 30 days, fixed (Loki refuses a longer query). Needs OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1 for the file path.

targets.expr: sum by (agk_role, agk_doc) (count_over_time({agk_project="$project"} |= "claude_code.tool_result" | tool_name="Read" | label_format agk_role=`{{ if eq .query_source "main" }}orchestrator{{ else }}{{ with regexReplaceAll "^.*:" .agent_name "" }}{{ if eq . "pm" }}pm{{ else if or (eq . "software-engineer") (eq . "frontend-engineer") }}engineer{{ else if eq . "qa-engineer" }}qa-claude{{ else if eq . "planner" }}planner{{ else }}other{{ end }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}{{ end }}` | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json file_path="file_path" | drop __error__, __error_details__ | label_format agk_doc=`{{ regexReplaceAll "^.*/((?:docs|\\.agents/skills|plugin/skills)/.+|AGENTS\\.md|CLAUDE\\.md)$" .file_path "${1}" }}` | agk_doc=~"(docs|\\.agents/skills|plugin/skills)/.+|AGENTS\\.md|CLAUDE\\.md" [$__range]))
